name: Sales Pipeline
description: Follow your deals from first contact to won, with a funnel, a forecast and next steps.
prompt: A simple sales CRM with deals, client, value, next step date, contact and notes, stages from lead to won or lost, a funnel chart, open value, a weighted forecast and overdue follow-ups in red.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Sigue tus ventas desde el primer contacto hasta cerrarlas, con embudo, previsión y próximos pasos.
